questions.question: Which trip length should be planned: the preferred 15–18 Feb 2027 (3 nights) or the 7-night window used for hotel totals?
questions.whatWeKnow: 15 Feb 2027 is a Monday and 18 Feb is a Thursday; 15–22 Feb 2027 is exactly 7 nights (calendar arithmetic).
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Which duration the traveler wants priced and booked.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Site uses 15–22 Feb 2027 as the 7-night planning case and keeps the 3-night preference visible.
questions.howToDiscover: Pick one window before requesting live quotes; all hotel totals depend on it.

questions.question: What is the real total price for a 7-night stay for two adults, including taxes and fees?
questions.whatWeKnow: citizenM publishes an undated 'from $395 / night' rate. Michelin states its hotel booking widget cannot book more than 31 days ahead.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Dated 2027 rates for any shortlisted hotel, taxes, resort/amenity fees and cancellation terms.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Left blank and flagged. No 7-night total is invented.
questions.howToDiscover: Check each hotel's own booking engine when the 2027 booking window opens; record screenshot/URL and date checked.

questions.question: Which shortlisted hotels actually have a private bathroom and a queen-size bed or larger for two adults on the chosen dates?
questions.whatWeKnow: Marriott's citizenM brand page states XL king bed, up to two adults, power shower and fast Wi-Fi. Other shortlisted hotels' room pages were not checked.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Room-type availability and bed/bath details for the remaining hotels.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Only citizenM Times Square meets the bed/bath requirement on an official page; the rest are flagged unverified.
questions.howToDiscover: Fetch each hotel's official rooms page and the exact room type shown for the booking dates.

questions.question: Which Michelin distinctions will be current during the February 2027 trip?
questions.whatWeKnow: As of 25 Nov 2026 the Michelin list shows 5 three-star, 14 two-star and 50 one-star NYC restaurants. The 2026 Northeast Cities ceremony is scheduled for 14 Dec 2026.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Awards that will be announced after this research date and before travel.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Use the live 25 Nov 2026 list and re-check after 14 Dec 2026.
questions.howToDiscover: Re-read the official Michelin star list immediately after the ceremony and update the data JSON.

questions.question: How many Michelin restaurants are within one hour by subway or bus of each hotel?
questions.whatWeKnow: Official addresses for 13 detailed rows and Michelin's official star list; no official door-to-door travel times for Feb 2027.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Routed travel times from each candidate hotel at the time of day you will travel.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Not ranked as fact. The site provides a link to live directions for every pair and a flagged proximity proxy instead.
questions.howToDiscover: Run one door-to-door routing query per hotel/restaurant pair, store the result with date/time and source, then recompute the ranking.

questions.question: What will a couple actually pay at each Michelin restaurant?
questions.whatWeKnow: Michelin publishes only $ to $$$$ bands. No official dated menu with a total for two was confirmed on the restaurant pages checked.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: 2027 menu prices, beverage pairings, service charge, tax and cancellation policies.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Blank and flagged; guide price band is shown instead.
questions.howToDiscover: Fetch each restaurant's official menu/pricing page shortly before booking and record a screenshot plus date.

questions.question: Are Broadway show titles and ticket prices available for the chosen dates?
questions.whatWeKnow: NYC Tourism's official update page lists several Broadway openings in spring 2027, after the proposed trip; TKTS publishes discount mechanics but no booth hours were verified.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: The February 2027 performance schedule, titles, prices and TKTS booth hours.
questions.provisionalAnswer: No show-specific rows are presented as verified.
questions.howToDiscover: Check each show's official site and TKTS official booth page when 2027 sales open.

questions.question: Which social-media accounts actually belong to each venue, and which posts are current?
questions.whatWeKnow: A YouTube review link was found for several rows. NYC Parks links its own Instagram and YouTube from its official site; NPS lists its park accounts on an official page.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Official account ownership for most restaurants and venues; whether linked reviews still represent current menus/hours.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Third-party links are labelled as such. Blank where no link could be confirmed.
questions.howToDiscover: Follow 'social' links from each venue's official website footer and record handle/URL plus the page that confirms ownership.

questions.question: What is the total budget ceiling for two adults, and what share of it is accommodation?
questions.whatWeKnow: Four hotels now have dated all-in totals for the same seven nights, spanning $1,305 to $5,220 - a 4x range.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: The ceiling, and therefore whether the $1,305 stay is 'good value' or 'the only option'.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Site ranks by verified attributes and shows the full price spread instead of assuming a budget.
questions.howToDiscover: State a total and an accommodation share; then the hotel shortlist collapses to one or two options.

questions.question: Which airport, at what airfare, and does the arrival allow a 19:00 dinner on day one?
questions.whatWeKnow: Three airports serve the city (JFK, LGA, EWR). Atera's Monday service starts at 19:00.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Airfare, arrival airport, transfer time and cost. No flight research was done in either session.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Day one is left light: check-in plus an evening dinner that can flex. Nothing time-critical before 19:00.
questions.howToDiscover: Price flights for 15 Feb and 22 Feb 2027, then re-time day one.

questions.question: What are typical mid-February conditions, and which activities are weather-dependent?
questions.whatWeKnow: Several planned activities are outdoors (Brooklyn Bridge walk, Central Park, the High Line, Top of the Rock terraces).
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Typical temperature and precipitation for 15-22 Feb; no climate source was checked by either session.
questions.provisionalAnswer: Indoor anchors (museums, dining) are scheduled on fixed days; outdoor items stay movable.
questions.howToDiscover: Add a climate-normals reference (for example National Weather Service climate data) and tag each activity indoor/outdoor.

questions.question: Are there mobility, dietary or accessibility requirements that must filter the shortlist?
questions.whatWeKnow: MICHELIN publishes facilities per restaurant (wheelchair access, vegetarian/vegan/halal/kosher options); hotels list accessible room types.
questions.whatWeDoNotKnow: Whether any requirement applies. One allergy or mobility need can eliminate half the starred list.
questions.provisionalAnswer: No filter applied; all rows carry their published facilities so a filter can be added without re-research.
questions.howToDiscover: State the requirement, then filter on the MICHELIN 'Services & Facilities' tags already in the records.

suggestions.title: Add a dated hotel quote workflow with official screenshots
suggestions.detail: When the booking window opens, capture a dated screenshot from each hotel's own booking page for 15–22 Feb 2027, including taxes and cancellation terms. This unblocks the largest cost decision.

suggestions.title: Run and store actual hotel-to-restaurant routing results
suggestions.detail: For each shortlisted hotel, route to each starred restaurant by subway/bus at 18:00 on a weekday and a Saturday; store duration and the routing URL. Then rank hotels by verified count under 60 minutes.

suggestions.title: Add an official-menu price capture for restaurants
suggestions.detail: Capture each restaurant's own menu/pricing page, compute a two-adult total, and show the date captured. Keep Michelin's $ band separate from a real total.

suggestions.title: Add social-source verification checkbox per row
suggestions.detail: Add a data field that records which official page confirms a social account, so third-party review links can be separated from official venue posts.

suggestions.title: Show a 3-night vs 7-night cost comparison
suggestions.detail: Add a side-by-side view for 15–18 Feb and 15–22 Feb once both have official quotes, including the extra four nights' cost.

suggestions.title: Add a post-ceremony Michelin re-check step
suggestions.detail: After 14 Dec 2026, re-fetch the official Michelin star list and update data/restaurants.json before any reservation decisions.

suggestions.title: Make the site filterable by 'confirmed today / needs re-check'
suggestions.detail: Add a client-side toggle that hides rows carrying flags, so a traveler can see only the fully verified subset at a glance.

suggestions.title: Add an itinerary timetable with travel buffers
suggestions.detail: Once routing data exists, generate a day-by-day plan with morning/afternoon/evening blocks and explicit transfer buffers.

suggestions.title: Show the flexibility premium in dollars on every hotel row
suggestions.detail: The gap between non-refundable and refundable is material and now measurable: 11 Howard is +$426 ($1,522 to $1,948) and The Beekman is +$454 ($4,488 to $4,942) for the same seven nights. Presenting it as an explicit 'insurance price' turns an abstract trade-off into a number.

suggestions.title: Complete the MICHELIN index to the official counters
suggestions.detail: Official counters read 5 three-star / 14 two-star / 50 one-star / 76 Bib Gourmand / 224 selected. The catalogue now holds 18 starred rows, so roughly 51 starred and all 300 unstarred listings remain. The list pages serve 48 rows at a time, so this is a pagination job with a fixed end point.

suggestions.title: Re-capture rates weekly and warn when a figure is stale
suggestions.detail: Every dated total on this site is a 2026-11-25 snapshot, and at least one depended on a promotion that expires 31 Dec 2026. A scheduled re-capture that overwrites the JSON and surfaces a diff would stop the page from going quietly out of date.

suggestions.title: Read hours from each venue's own page in a real browser session
suggestions.detail: Several official pages are client-rendered: le-bernardin.com/menus returned one image, elevenmadisonpark.com returned a slide carousel, moma.org failed to load twice. Those blanks close immediately with a JavaScript-enabled session, and each capture should store the exact quoted text.

flags.title: Michelin ceremony falls between research and travel
flags.detail: The 2026 Northeast Cities ceremony is scheduled for 14 Dec 2026; star assignments may change before the February 2027 trip.

flags.title: No verified 7-night hotel total or cheapest booking window - PARTIALLY RESOLVED
flags.detail: Resolved for four hotels on 2026-11-25: Booking.com returned live 7-night totals for 15-22 Feb 2027 (Hyatt Place NY/Chelsea $1,305 all-in, Arlo NoMad $1,428, 11 Howard $1,774, The Beekman $5,220) with the exact rate URL and capture date per row. Still open: no hotel's own booking engine was read, eight of twelve candidates remain unpriced, and no other week in the 15 Feb - 23 Mar window was priced. See F10 for the snapshot/expiry risk.

flags.title: Trip length mismatch in the request
flags.detail: Preferred trip is 3 nights (15–18 Feb 2027) but the hotel-pricing request asks for a 7-night total. Both are shown; no single assumption was silently chosen.

flags.title: Conflicting official snippets for The Met's midweek hours
flags.detail: Different official Met pages/snippets showed Wednesday closed vs open, and Thursday hours differed. The table uses the Page 1 listing but flags re-checking.

flags.title: 11 Howard guest score differs across Michelin pages
flags.detail: Hotel page showed 18 and the Le Coucou restaurant page showed 18.1; both are recorded rather than averaging them.

flags.title: Sushi Sho social search returned a different city
flags.detail: YouTube results for 'Sushi Sho' referred to the Hawaii location; no NYC-specific social link was verified, so the field is blank.

flags.title: NYPL official pages showed different weekly hours
flags.detail: Different official NYPL pages displayed different hours; the regular-hours page is used and flagged for re-check.

flags.title: Social links are third-party reviews, not official posts
flags.detail: Most YouTube links were found via search and are labelled as third-party. Only NYC Parks and NPS links were confirmed from official pages.

flags.title: Repo had no prior content to reconcile
flags.detail: Initial commit contained only README.md; no pre-existing data or site files conflicted with this work.

flags.title: Dated hotel totals are aggregator snapshots and one depends on an expiring promotion
flags.detail: All four dated totals come from Booking.com rate pages read 2026-11-25, not from the hotels' own booking engines. Arlo NoMad's $1,213.96 pre-tax depended on a 'Black Friday Deal - 39% off, valid on stays 19 Nov 2026 to 31 Dec 2027'. The same room after that promotion ends will cost more. Treat every total as a dated observation.

flags.title: Starred catalogue is 18 of 69 - the cluster picture is a sample, not a census
flags.detail: The official counters total 69 starred restaurants. This catalogue holds 18, so any statement about where starred dining 'concentrates' is based on a subset. Same-ZIP proximity claims were therefore kept as a floor and no travel time was inferred.

flags.title: MTA fare is $3, not the $2.90 still quoted in cached guides
flags.detail: The official fares page read 2026-11-25 states $3 for subway and local / limited / rush / SBS buses and $7.25 for express buses. Older guides and cached pages still show $2.90; any transport budget built on that figure is out of date.

flags.title: Airfare, theatre and per-person menu prices remain unpriced
flags.detail: No flight pricing, no theatre tickets and no restaurant menu price was captured by either session. Restaurant bills are the largest unpriced line in the plan, and every starred row sits in the $$$$ band. The budget therefore shows verified line items only and no grand total.

flags.title: Social media ownership not fully verified for every row
flags.detail: User request requires YouTube/TikTok/Instagram links for every restaurant/activity. Many rows have third-party review links; some have no social link; only a subset are confirmed official (e.g., NPS/NYC Parks official pages, Gabriel Kreuther sameAs on gknyc.com). Session arena/eea68c1e-nyfun2 added/labelled a few links with verification notes but did not confirm ownership on every venue's official site. Rows without a confirmed official account should be treated as unverified until checked on the venue's own website/footer.
